sources.title: kaela kovalskia (1st costume)
sources.excerpt:
It consists of a [[black scarf]], a [[long dress|long]] [[white dress|white]] [[skin tight]]/[[impossible dress|impossible]] [[pencil dress]] with a [[fur collar]], [[black sleeves|black]] [[gloved sleeves]] and a [[side slit]] revealing a [[bodystocking]]/[[see-through legwear|see-through]] [[pantyhose]] underneath, a [[single glove|single]] [[red gloves|red]] welding glove on her left hand, a [[red belt]] with several tool including three small metal plates and a [[mallet]], a [[long sleeves|long-sleeved]] [[open coat|open]] [[black coat]] which she wears [[off shoulder]] [[coat partially removed|resting on her elbows]] and [[black boots|black]] [[platform boots|platform]] [[ankle boots]] with red [[colored shoe soles]]. She also wears a miniature steel bar as a [[single earring]] on her left ear.

h4. Appearance

* !asset #21023548: Profil
